an10.80:1.3: ‘Anatthaṃ me acari, taṃ kut 'ettha labbhā' ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti,
an10.80:1.4: ‘anatthaṃ me carati, taṃ kut' ettha labbhā' ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti,
an10.80:1.5: ‘anatthaṃ me carissati, taṃ kut' ettha labbhā' ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti,
an10.80:1.8: carissati, taṃ kut' ettha labbhā' ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti, ‘appiyassa me amanāpassa atthaṃ acari . . .
an10.80:1.10: atthaṃ carissati, taṃ kut' ettha labbhā' ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti,
an10.80:1.12: Ime kho bhikkhave dasa āghātapaṭivinayā ti.
